name: Global Bound Masking
description: Replaces a local per-edge constraint with a global sum over all edges. By choosing a function whose maximum possible value over the domain is 2.5, and setting the target sum to exactly 2.5 * m, the global constraint can only be satisfied if every individual edge achieves the maximum. This forces the same local condition (endpoints must be different) but requires an intermediate mathematical deduction step (recognizing the global sum equals the theoretical maximum) before the graph-coloring structure becomes visible, preventing shallow pattern-matching.
